_comment: Synthetic resume content bundle (spec 013). The engine is persona-free: import YOUR bundle into the profile store as kind resume_data; this example documents the shape and doubles as the public test fixture (services/api/tests/test_resume.py). Every bullet must appear verbatim in your resume_truth or achievements document.
profile_summary: Brings end-to-end frontend ownership across conversion-critical flows, shared UI systems, architecture, and quality engineering.

bullet_pool.r1_b1: Took over full frontend ownership of a Vue 3 / Nuxt platform for a fintech client.
bullet_pool.r1_b2: Led a Nuxt migration to a vertical-slice architecture, codifying ownership and dependency direction to keep changes reviewable.
bullet_pool.r1_b3: Established a token-driven design-system layer, shipping reusable primitives with Storybook documentation.
bullet_pool.r1_b4: Added frontend observability with Mixpanel, Sentry, and structured telemetry to improve release traceability.
bullet_pool.r1_b5: Designed a release pipeline with semantic versioning, release tracking, and CI quality checks.
bullet_pool.r1_b6: Improved frontend developer experience and CI reliability by standardizing lockfile generation.
bullet_pool.r2_b1: Owned a signup funnel handling ~100K applications/year.
bullet_pool.r2_b3: Built shared UI libraries with Storybook and semantic versioning.
bullet_pool.r2_b4: Worked with product and backend on typed API contracts, validation, and observable error handling.
bullet_pool.r2_b5: Instituted CI/CD quality gates and automated performance checks.
bullet_pool.r2_b6: Received a company-wide engineering quality award.
bullet_pool.r3_b1: Served as primary frontend owner for React/TypeScript SPAs and dashboards.
bullet_pool.r3_b2: Raised Lighthouse scores from the 40s to the 90s.
bullet_pool.r3_b3: Built small backend-adjacent utilities with Node.js and AWS Lambda.
bullet_pool.ach_1: Grew signup funnel completion from 50% to 75% across ~100K annual applications, directly improving customer acquisition.
bullet_pool.ach_2: Raised Lighthouse scores from the 40s to the 90s.

bullet_pool.ach_6: Built end-to-end frontend quality infrastructure: token-driven design system, deterministic test suites, CI quality gates, and production observability.
